scenarios.title: A｜保持沉默
scenarios.setting: 会议中，玩家发现 Chris 对领导说了一件明显与事实不符的事情，但暂时不想介入。

turns.text: I sent the client the updated version on Friday, but they never responded.
Didn’t Chris send that on Monday? I thought you were there.

turns.prompt: 你想简短回应自己记得的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, that’s what I remember too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s what I remember too.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: I noticed that, but I’m not going to say anything right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed that, but I’m not going to say anything right now.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: I’m not sure what’s going on, so I’d rather stay out of it for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure what’s going on, so I’d rather stay out of it for now.
feedback.explanation: “stay out of it”表示不介入这件事，适合说明不想卷入争论或八卦的立场。

choices.text: I don’t have the full story, so I don’t want to jump to conclusions.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have the full story, so I don’t want to jump to conclusions.
feedback.explanation: “jump to conclusions”表示过早下结论；否定使用时说明想先核实事实。

choices.text: I know he’s lying, but it’s not my business.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s what I remember too.
feedback.explanation: “I know he’s lying”先认定恶意；若不想参与，可直接表示暂不下结论或希望保持中立。

turns.text: Do you think we should tell the manager?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I’d rather understand what happened first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather understand what happened first.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Not yet. Let’s make sure we have the facts.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. Let’s make sure we have the facts.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: I think I’ll leave it alone unless it starts affecting my work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ll leave it alone unless it starts affecting my work.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m going to stay out of it for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m going to stay out of it for now.
feedback.explanation: “stay out of it”表示不介入这件事，适合说明不想卷入争论或八卦的立场。

scenarios.title: B｜询问对方
scenarios.setting: 会议结束后，玩家私下找到 Chris。

turns.prompt: 你想向同事询问会上那句话的具体意思，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I ask you about something you said in the meeting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you about something you said in the meeting?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I was a little confused by something you mentioned earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was a little confused by something you mentioned earlier.
feedback.explanation: “confused”指困惑的，适合承认尚未理解。

choices.text: You said you sent the file on Friday, but I thought it went out on Monday.

feedback.naturalExpression: You said you sent the file on Friday, but I thought it went out on Monday.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

choices.text: Maybe I’m remembering it wrong, but wasn’t the file sent on Monday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe I’m remembering it wrong, but wasn’t the file sent on Monday?
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Why did you lie about when you sent it?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you about something you said in the meeting?
feedback.explanation: “lie”将日期不一致认定为故意说谎；先指出记录上的时间，再请对方解释差异。

turns.text: I don’t know. Maybe I got the dates mixed up.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己只是想弄清事情经过，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I just wanted to make sure I understood what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I just wanted to make sure I understood what happened.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: That’s possible. I remember us finishing it on Monday morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s possible. I remember us finishing it on Monday morning.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: I have the email from Monday if you want to check.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the email from Monday if you want to check.
feedback.explanation: “from … to …”把起止时间或范围一起说清，适合确认完整安排。

choices.text: I’m asking because the timeline could matter if the client complains.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m asking because the timeline could matter if the client complains.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: Yeah, you’re right. It was Monday. I shouldn’t have said Friday.

turns.prompt: 你想建议对方向经理澄清错误的信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I think you should probably correct that with the manager.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I think you should probably correct that with the manager.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Thanks for being honest about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for being honest about it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I’d rather we clear it up now than have it become a bigger issue later.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather we clear it up now than have it become a bigger issue later.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

scenarios.title: C｜告诉相关人员
scenarios.setting: 这件事已经影响到项目责任划分，玩家决定向领导说明。

turns.text: You wanted to speak to me?

turns.prompt: 你想提醒对方有需要了解的时间线信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. I think there’s something about the timeline you should know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I think there’s something about the timeline you should know.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I wanted to clarify something that came up in yesterday’s meeting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to clarify something that came up in yesterday’s meeting.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: There’s a discrepancy between what was said in the meeting and the records I have.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a discrepancy between what was said in the meeting and the records I have.
feedback.explanation: “discrepancy”指两份说法或记录不一致，能客观指出差异，而不先判断谁在说谎。

choices.text: I don’t want to make accusations, but I think you should see this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to make accusations, but I think you should see this.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.prompt: 关于「发现同事撒谎」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Chris said the file was sent on Friday, but it was actually sent on Monday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Chris said the file was sent on Friday, but it was actually sent on Monday.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: The email record shows that the client didn’t receive it until Monday afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: The email record shows that the client didn’t receive it until Monday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I have the messages here if you’d like to see them.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the messages here if you’d like to see them.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I thought it was important to clarify because it affects the project timeline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought it was important to clarify because it affects the project timeline.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

turns.prompt: 关于「发现同事撒谎」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. Here’s the original email with the timestamp.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Here’s the original email with the timestamp.
feedback.explanation: “original”指原件或原始版本；与复印件、修改版区分。

choices.text: I’m certain about the date. I was involved in sending the final version.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m certain about the date. I was involved in sending the final version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: You can check the email thread as well.

feedback.naturalExpression: You can check the email thread as well.
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I just wanted to make sure you had the correct information.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I just wanted to make sure you had the correct information.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Of course. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。
